Choose a party Pokémon
to offer for Wonder Trade.

Saving and contacting the server.
Do not turn off the power.

Couldn’t connect to the internet.
Check your Nintendo WFC settings
and that your access point is
in range, then try again.

Something went wrong while
contacting Wonder Trade.
Please try again. If it keeps
happening, note the code below.

Cannot offer this Pokémon.
Keep another usable Pokémon.
No Eggs, mail, capsules,
Aprijuice or Spiky-eared PICHU.

An identical or damaged Pokémon
in your party or PC blocks this.

Trade a party Pokémon with a
random player. It waits safely
on the server until matched.
Check back to collect it, or
cancel before a match.
One offer per save.

Trade recovery required.
Connect to try again.

Keep this save and its
recovery files.

Offer the selected Pokémon?
It will leave your party.

Your trade is pending. Choose
Collect result to check it.

Collect your trade result? Trade
evolution keeps current moves.

Cancel an unmatched offer? If
matched, collect it instead.

Trade completed! Your Pokémon
is in your party or PC.

Offer cancelled. Your Pokémon
is back in your party or PC.

The server rejected the offer.
Your Pokémon has been restored.

Another copy of this save traded
first. Your Pokémon is restored.

No partner yet. Your Pokémon is
still waiting. Check again later.

Your result is still pending. Make
room in your party or PC first.

Wonder Trade needs more play.
Keep playing, then try again.

This game can’t hold the received
Pokémon. It stays on the server.

Save your adventure before
using Wonder Trade.
